quests.desc: Hey, thanks for coming over to TextWorld! Please close the hatch.

It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Your first objective is to assure that the hatch is shut. After closing the hatch, make an effort to move south. After that, retrieve the type 6 keycard from the table. And then, take a trip north. Once you get through with that, make absolutely sure that the type 6 locker in the spare room is unlocked. After that, ensure that the type 6 locker is open. Having opened the type 6 locker, take the keycard from the type 6 locker in the spare room. After that, attempt to move south. And then, make it so that the safe is unlocked. After that, open the safe within the washroom. After that, pick up the passkey from the safe inside the washroom. Then, make an attempt to take a trip north. Then, Put the passkey into the hatch to lock it. Alright, thanks!

objective: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an profound round of TextWorld? You do! First of all, you could, like, doublecheck that the hatch is shut. After that, head south. After that, recover the type 6 keycard from the table. Then, travel north. With that over with, check that the type 6 locker is unlocked with the type 6 keycard. Then, ensure that the type 6 locker is open. Then, retrieve the keycard from the type 6 locker. And then, try to head south. If you can manage that, doublecheck that the safe inside the washroom is unlocked. If you have unlocked the safe, make it so that the safe inside the washroom is ajar. Then, retrieve the passkey from the safe. After that, make an attempt to venture north. And then, lock the hatch within the spare room. Alright, thanks!
